archive-one.title: Archive I — The Beginning of the Journey
archive-one.subtitle: Narrative and dungeon mechanics

opening.title: Opening
narration: I have recorded countless journeys through the Dark Forge. Some ended before the first door. Others reached places that should never have been forgotten.
They all began the same way: with a choice.
opening.instruction: Learn the first steps of an expedition.

choose-hero.title: Choosing a hero
narration: Not all who cross the Véu carry the same strengths. Each brings abilities, limitations, and choices that may shape the path ahead.
choose-hero.instruction: Select a hero for your expedition. You can also inspect their card.

group.title: The group
narration: Some travel alone. Others share the journey. The number of those who walk together does not eliminate the risk. It merely changes the decisions they must make.
group.instruction: An expedition can have one to four heroes. Add more if you wish, or continue with your chosen hero.

start.title: Starting the expedition
narration: Once the first step is taken, the path ceases to be a possibility. It becomes a record.
start.instruction: Use the Start game button to enter the training board.

board.title: Getting to know the dungeon
narration: The Dark Forge does not reveal all its paths. Each room shows only part of what awaits those who choose to press on.
board.instruction: Observe the areas of the board.
highlights: The current room appears here. No room has been revealed yet.
This is the group of heroes you chose.
Creatures encountered appear in this area.
The phase control guides the expedition's next action.

reveal.title: Revealing a room
narration: Each passage conceals what has yet to be discovered. An open door may reveal obstacles, encounters, or opportunities.
reveal.instruction: Use Reveal room. The game engine will draw and apply a room.

encounter.title: Encounters and progression
narration: Not every passage remains empty. Some presences bar the way. Some encounters leave something behind. The journey continues only when its conditions have been met.
encounter.instruction: Observe the revealed room and any creatures within it. Combat and spoils will be covered in the next archives.
highlights: This is the room the engine revealed for the expedition.
These creatures prevent progress until the encounter is resolved.
XP, artifacts, and the boss-related condition appear here.

goal.title: The expedition's objective
narration: The first door does not define a journey. Nor does the final battle reveal all that came before it.
In the Dark Forge, every decision changes what may be faced ahead.
goal.instruction: Explore the dungeon, face its challenges, and advance toward Azhakar. Victory depends on the expedition's actual conditions.

completion.title: Archive I complete
narration: This archive records the beginning of a journey. What follows still awaits those who choose to go on.
I recorded it.

combat-opening.title: The encounter
narration: Some presences guard the paths of the Forge. Others seem to have been born from the very cracks in the Véu.
There is not always a way through without confrontation.
combat-opening.instruction: In this archive, you will learn how to face the creatures encountered in the dungeon.

combat-participants.title: Identifying the participants
narration: On one side, those who chose to move forward. On the other, what rises to stop them.
combat-participants.instruction: Observe your hero and the creature. Health decreases as damage is dealt.
highlights: This card represents the hero available to act.
This is the creature blocking the way.
The creature's current and maximum Health appear here.
The hero card shows their Health and resources relevant to combat.

combat-select-hero.title: Selecting the hero
narration: A decision needs someone to carry it out. Before the strike, there is the one who chooses it.
combat-select-hero.instruction: Select your hero to initiate an attack.

combat-select-target.title: Choosing the target
narration: Strength without direction decides nothing. A strike needs a destination.
combat-select-target.instruction: Select the creature. Watch the roll and use Resolve attack to complete this first action.

combat-drag.title: Drag and drop
narration: Different paths can lead to the same destination. The intention remains. Only the gesture changes.
combat-drag.instruction: Drag the hero card onto the creature. On touch devices, select both cards again.

combat-dice.title: The dice
narration: Not every intention reaches its destination. Even the most precise strike passes through a moment of uncertainty.
combat-dice.instruction: Observe the dice and their actual modifiers. Once the animation ends, use Resolve attack.

combat-result.title: Hit and damage
narration: Not every strike reaches its target. And not every strike that lands has the same consequence.
combat-result.instruction: Compare the result recorded in the Journal with the creature's previous and current Health.
highlights: The defeated creature has left the active enemies area. Its final Health is shown in the Archivist's panel.
Here is the hero's remaining Health.

combat-action.title: Completing the action
narration: An action once completed cannot be repeated merely because its result displeased the one who chose it.
Every opportunity used changes what can still happen.
combat-action.instruction: Observe who attacked and had their attack opportunity consumed. Being selected, using an ability, or exhausting an item does not, by itself, count as attacking.

combat-completion.title: Archive II complete — Combat
narration: An encounter ends. Its consequences remain.
From what was lost or preserved, the next record is born.
combat-completion.instruction: The engine has confirmed the completion conditions. Choose how to proceed.

archive-three.title: Archive III — The Weight of the Journey
archive-three.subtitle: Items and equipment

items-opening.title: The Weight of the Journey
narration: Some cross the Forge relying on their own strength. Others entrust their survival to what they can carry.
But owning something does not mean knowing how to use it.
items-opening.instruction: In this archive, you will learn to organize equipment, use items, and understand their effects.

inventory-open.title: Getting to know the inventory
narration: Every journey imposes limits. What is carried must have a place. What is used must be within reach.
inventory-open.instruction: Select the hero and open the group inventory.

inventory-slots.title: Equipment slots
narration: Each tool requires its place. And no traveler can bear more upon their body than their limits allow.
inventory-slots.instruction: Observe the two clothing slots, two hand slots, the amulet slot, and three backpack slots.
highlights: Two clothing items can occupy separate slots.
Two hands can hold one-handed items or a two-handed weapon.
The amulet has its own slot.
The backpack holds up to three items; open it to see them.

item-inspect.title: Inspecting an item
narration: An object may seem simple until its properties are understood.
There is power in what is known. And risk in what is ignored.
item-inspect.instruction: Open the backpack, inspect a card, and close the details to continue.

equip-dagger.title: Equipping a weapon
narration: A sheathed blade does not change a strike. Only when wielded can it fulfill the purpose for which it was forged.
equip-dagger.instruction: Equip the Rusty Dagger from the backpack in an available hand slot.

equip-axe.title: One hand or two
narration: Not every weapon can be held the same way. Some require one hand. Others require both.
equip-axe.instruction: In the backpack, choose Swap on the Ruined Hall Axe and tap a hand slot. Watch the previous items being rearranged.

equip-armor.title: Clothing and passive effects
narration: Some objects have effects that require no action. Their presence, when properly used, changes what their bearer can endure.
equip-armor.instruction: Equip the Reinforced Leather Armor and observe the effect's source on the card and in the Journal.

use-item.title: Using an item
narration: Some objects remain silent until someone chooses to awaken what they hold within.
use-item.instruction: Swap the axe for the Precision Potion in the backpack. Then use the equipped potion with the Use button.

item-states.title: Exhausted and consumable items
narration: Not every resource remains after use. Some become exhausted. Others vanish, leaving only the consequences of their use.
item-states.instruction: Compare the potion discarded at the previous checkpoint with the Warm Blood Charm exhausted in this combat. Open the Journal to check their states; the hero can now attack this round.

items-completion.title: Archive III complete — The Weight of the Journey
narration: What one carries may offer protection, strength, or one last chance.
But no tool makes decisions for the one who wields it.
I recorded it.
items-completion.instruction: You have learned to inspect, equip, and use items. The next archive will cover abilities and powers.

abilities-opening.title: What Each One Carries
narration: The same passage does not demand the same answers from everyone who crosses it.
Some abilities are revealed through choice. Others await the moment when their presence becomes necessary.
abilities-opening.instruction: In this archive, you will use abilities, prepare reactions, and discover the heroes' powers.

abilities-inspect.title: Understanding Abilities
narration: A traveler's strength lies not only in their weapons. There is knowledge, instinct, and talent that no blade can replace.
abilities-inspect.instruction: Open the Hunter's panel, review their ability and power, then select the portrait to see the full card.

prey-mark.title: A Manually Activated Ability
narration: Some refuse to face a threat before understanding it.
Identifying a target is also a way to prepare for what comes next.
prey-mark.instruction: Use Prey Mark and choose a valid creature in the target selector.

hunter-attack.title: An Ability Is Not an Attack
narration: Not every choice is a strike. Some merely establish the conditions for what is yet to happen.
hunter-attack.instruction: The Mark preserved the attack opportunity. Select the Hunter, choose a creature, and resolve the actual attack.

fury-prepare.title: Preparing a Reaction
narration: Some powers should not be awakened before the moment they are needed.
Some await a decision. After that, only the event remains.
fury-prepare.instruction: Open the Barbarian's panel and prepare Crimson Fury. Preparation can be canceled before the attack.

fury-trigger.title: The Moment of Fury
narration: When an opportunity arises, what was prepared finds its moment.
fury-trigger.instruction: Attack with the Barbarian. Watch Fury activate automatically, without further confirmation.

hero-power.title: A Hero's Power
narration: Some abilities accompany those who travel through the Forge, as marks of their very nature.
Their reach is not infinite. Their use, too, is governed by the rules of the path.
hero-power.instruction: Open the Warrior's panel and use Unbreakable Bastion Guard. Observe the protection and the once-per-game limit.

passive-effect.title: Passive Effects
narration: Not every power requires a command. Some remain present as long as their source exists.
passive-effect.instruction: Observe the equipped Low-Flame Charm, its projected effect, and its source card in the Journal. Continuous effects do not require manual activation.

ability-limits.title: Costs and Limits
narration: Every possibility has its conditions. What has been used cannot always be claimed again at once.
ability-limits.instruction: Check the power used and why it is unavailable. The power's usage limit does not consume the hero's attack.

abilities-completion.title: Archive IV complete — Will and Power
narration: You now know the first limits of your strength. You know what can be awakened by choice, what must wait, and what remains even in silence.
But knowing a path is not the same as walking it.
What happens next has yet to be recorded.
I recorded it. Now, I merely recount it.
abilities-completion.instruction: You have completed all four Heroic Ascension training archives. Choose how to proceed.
